package ap

// ddsonic composed-stage observer (D10; M3b2 plan v7 §2.3, §2.7). Like the
// other contract helpers, this file exists only in the overlay the composed
// stage builds over a staged copy of go-librespot; ap_fake_helper.go.txt is
// not edited.
//
// It adds, for the composed tests in external/spotify:
//   - a drain of the fake's conns channel from the moment the fake starts,
//     so that no handshake goroutine can block on that 16-slot channel;
//   - for each authenticated connection, a forwarder that is the only
//     consumer of the original Packets channel (the field is never
//     reassigned) and records when the server's read ended, and whether the
//     fake had begun closing by then: if not, the client closed its socket;
//   - the fake's stop and restore halves, separated: Stop is Close's first
//     half and consumes its once, so Close can no longer restore anything;
//     Restore is Close's second half, under a once of its own;
//   - the connMu accessor for the happens-before set H, and the client
//     connection's local address, for correlating a connection with the
//     access point that dialled it.

import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// DDSonicComposedFake is the fake access point with the composed stage's
// observation.
type DDSonicComposedFake struct {
	F *DDSonicFakeAP

	mu      sync.Mutex
	conns   []*DDSonicComposedConn
	changed chan struct{} // closed and replaced when a connection is added
	// maxOccupancy is the largest len(conns) the drain observed just before
	// a receive: an observation of the channel's occupancy, which producers
	// change concurrently, not an exact historical peak.
	maxOccupancy int
	autoKey      func(req Packet) []byte

	workers     sync.WaitGroup // the drain and the forwarders
	restoreOnce sync.Once
}

// DDSonicComposedConn is one authenticated connection as the fake saw it.
type DDSonicComposedConn struct {
	C     *DDSonicFakeConn
	Index int
	// Remote is the server side's view of the client's address: equal to the
	// client connection's local address.
	Remote string

	mu       sync.Mutex
	packets  []Packet
	cursor   int
	notify   chan struct{} // closed and replaced when a packet arrives or the read ends
	ended    bool
	endedAt  time.Time
	byClient bool
}

// DDSonicComposedStart starts the fake and its observer.
func DDSonicComposedStart() (*DDSonicComposedFake, error) {
	f, err := DDSonicContractFakeAP()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	o := &DDSonicComposedFake{F: f, changed: make(chan struct{})}
	o.workers.Add(1)
	go o.drain()
	return o, nil
}

func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) drain() {
	defer o.workers.Done()
	for {
		o.observeOccupancy()
		select {
		case c := <-o.F.conns:
			o.add(c) // MUTATION-POINT R29-4
		case <-o.F.closing:
			for {
				select {
				case c := <-o.F.conns:
					o.add(c)
				default:
					return
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) observeOccupancy() {
	n := len(o.F.conns)
	o.mu.Lock()
	if n > o.maxOccupancy {
		o.maxOccupancy = n
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
}

func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) add(c *DDSonicFakeConn) {
	cc := &DDSonicComposedConn{C: c, notify: make(chan struct{})}
	if ra := c.conn.RemoteAddr(); ra != nil {
		cc.Remote = ra.String()
	}
	o.mu.Lock()
	cc.Index = len(o.conns)
	o.conns = append(o.conns, cc)
	close(o.changed)
	o.changed = make(chan struct{})
	o.mu.Unlock()
	o.workers.Add(1)
	go o.forward(cc)
}

// forward is the one consumer of the connection's original Packets channel.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) forward(cc *DDSonicComposedConn) {
	defer o.workers.Done()
	for pkt := range cc.C.Packets {
		cc.mu.Lock()
		cc.packets = append(cc.packets, pkt)
		close(cc.notify)
		cc.notify = make(chan struct{})
		cc.mu.Unlock()
		o.mu.Lock()
		auto := o.autoKey
		o.mu.Unlock()
		if auto != nil && pkt.Type == PacketTypeRequestKey {
			if key := auto(pkt); key != nil {
				_ = cc.C.AnswerKey(pkt, key)
			}
		}
	}
	closing := false
	select {
	case <-o.F.closing:
		closing = true
	default:
	}
	cc.mu.Lock()
	cc.ended, cc.endedAt, cc.byClient = true, time.Now(), !closing
	close(cc.notify)
	cc.notify = make(chan struct{})
	cc.mu.Unlock()
}

// SetAutoKey makes the observer answer every key request with key(req), or
// stop answering when key is nil or returns nil.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) SetAutoKey(key func(req Packet) []byte) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	o.autoKey = key
	o.mu.Unlock()
}

// Addr is the fake's listening address.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Addr() string { return o.F.ln.Addr().String() }

// Accepted is how many connections the fake has accepted, including those
// whose handshake failed or was refused.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Accepted() int {
	o.F.mu.Lock()
	defer o.F.mu.Unlock()
	return len(o.F.all)
}

// Logins is how many connections completed their login.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Logins() int { return o.F.Logins() }

// Occupancy is the largest occupancy of the fake's conns channel the drain
// observed before a receive, and the channel's capacity (16). It is an
// observation: it neither excludes a larger momentary occupancy nor shows
// that no producer ever waited.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Occupancy() (maxObserved, capacity int) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	return o.maxOccupancy, cap(o.F.conns)
}

// Drained is how many authenticated connections the drain has taken from
// the fake's conns channel and registered.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Drained() int {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	return len(o.conns)
}

// Conns is a snapshot of the authenticated connections so far.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Conns() []*DDSonicComposedConn {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]*DDSonicComposedConn(nil), o.conns...)
}

// Conn waits up to d for the i-th authenticated connection.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Conn(i int, d time.Duration) *DDSonicComposedConn {
	deadline := time.After(d)
	for {
		o.mu.Lock()
		if i < len(o.conns) {
			c := o.conns[i]
			o.mu.Unlock()
			return c
		}
		changed := o.changed
		o.mu.Unlock()
		select {
		case <-changed:
		case <-deadline:
			return nil
		}
	}
}

// Wait is the next packet of the given type the client sent on this
// connection, skipping others, or false after d or when the read ended.
func (cc *DDSonicComposedConn) Wait(typ PacketType, d time.Duration) (Packet, bool) {
	deadline := time.After(d)
	for {
		cc.mu.Lock()
		for cc.cursor < len(cc.packets) {
			pkt := cc.packets[cc.cursor]
			cc.cursor++
			if pkt.Type == typ {
				cc.mu.Unlock()
				return pkt, true
			}
		}
		if cc.ended {
			cc.mu.Unlock()
			return Packet{}, false
		}
		notify := cc.notify
		cc.mu.Unlock()
		select {
		case <-notify:
		case <-deadline:
			return Packet{}, false
		}
	}
}

// Count is how many packets of the given type the client has sent on this
// connection.
func (cc *DDSonicComposedConn) Count(typ PacketType) int {
	cc.mu.Lock()
	defer cc.mu.Unlock()
	n := 0
	for _, p := range cc.packets {
		if p.Type == typ {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// Ended reports whether the server's read of this connection has ended,
// when, and whether the fake had not begun closing by then (the client
// closed its socket).
func (cc *DDSonicComposedConn) Ended() (ended, byClient bool, at time.Time) {
	cc.mu.Lock()
	defer cc.mu.Unlock()
	return cc.ended, cc.byClient, cc.endedAt
}

// WaitEnded waits up to d for the server's read to end.
func (cc *DDSonicComposedConn) WaitEnded(d time.Duration) bool {
	deadline := time.After(d)
	for {
		cc.mu.Lock()
		ended, notify := cc.ended, cc.notify
		cc.mu.Unlock()
		if ended {
			return true
		}
		select {
		case <-notify:
		case <-deadline:
			return false
		}
	}
}

// Stop is the fake's Close without its restore half: it closes closing, the
// listener and every server connection, and touches neither serverSigPubKey
// nor ddsonicFakeOpen. It consumes the fake's once, so a later Close does
// nothing.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Stop() {
	f := o.F
	f.once.Do(func() {
		close(f.closing)
		_ = f.ln.Close()
		f.mu.Lock()
		for _, c := range f.all {
			_ = c.Close()
		}
		f.mu.Unlock()
	})
}

// Stopped reports whether Stop (or Close) has run.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Stopped() bool {
	select {
	case <-o.F.closing:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// Restore is the fake's Close's restore half: the package's key back, and
// the fake's hold on ddsonicFakeOpen released. It runs once. The harness
// calls it only at T10 on the success path, after Stop (plan v7 §2.3).
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) Restore() {
	o.restoreOnce.Do(func() {
		serverSigPubKey = o.F.sdkKey
		ddsonicFakeOpen.Unlock()
	})
}

// JoinWorkers waits up to d for the drain and every forwarder to end.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) JoinWorkers(d time.Duration) bool {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		o.workers.Wait()
		close(done)
	}()
	select {
	case <-done:
		return true
	case <-time.After(d):
		return false
	}
}

// SigIsFixtures reports whether the package's signature key is this fake's.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) SigIsFixtures() bool {
	return serverSigPubKey == &o.F.key.PublicKey
}

// SigIsSDKs reports whether the package's signature key is the SDK's own.
func (o *DDSonicComposedFake) SigIsSDKs() bool { return serverSigPubKey == o.F.sdkKey }

// DDSonicComposedFakeOpenTryLock tries ddsonicFakeOpen. If it was free the
// lock is released again at once and true is returned: the caller records
// the observation, and the state is left as it was found.
func DDSonicComposedFakeOpenTryLock() bool {
	if ddsonicFakeOpen.TryLock() {
		ddsonicFakeOpen.Unlock()
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// DDSonicComposedConnMuSync takes and releases a's connMu. Taken after a's
// receive loop has ended, it orders every earlier section under connMu (each
// reconnect's handshake) before what follows it (the set H).
func DDSonicComposedConnMuSync(a *Accesspoint) {
	a.connMu.Lock()
	_ = a.conn
	a.connMu.Unlock()
}

// DDSonicComposedLocalAddr is a's current connection's local address, or ""
// when it has none.
func DDSonicComposedLocalAddr(a *Accesspoint) string {
	a.connMu.RLock()
	defer a.connMu.RUnlock()
	if a.conn == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if la := a.conn.LocalAddr(); la != nil {
		return la.String()
	}
	return ""
}

// DDSonicComposedAPDone reports whether a's Done is closed.
func DDSonicComposedAPDone(a *Accesspoint) bool {
	select {
	case <-a.Done():
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
